attestation_boundary.inventories: Institution/museum corroborate Elder24 vs Younger16;complete edition-specific identity/order fixtures still pending. Anglo-Saxon futhorc is independently scoped.
attestation_boundary.names: Separate reconstructed proto-names,attested language-specific names,normalized aliases,transliterations and display glyphs.
attestation_boundary.poems: Historical symbolic stanzas and linguistic names are distinct from contemporary fortunes or reversed meanings. Different poems may conflict;retain source/tradition identifiers.
attestation_boundary.casting: Historical marked-lot and rune-magic leads need original passage/translation verification;do not infer a fully documented24-rune modern casting system from a generic lot-drawing reference.
attestation_boundary.blank: Modern named variant only;no blank automatically inserted into historical alphabets.
attestation_boundary.reversals: Unverified until named modern procedure inspected. Symmetric glyphs,rotation180,mirroring and face-down state are different concepts;do not assign Tarot reversal meanings.

feasibility.first_scope: One source-bounded Elder24 symbolic profile with all24 meaningful entries only if legitimate source/rights and reconstruction limits are verified;manual and reproducible seeded1/3-rune draws with editorial or documented positions. A directly attested poem-specific profile is an alternative,not an unnamed merge.
feasibility.source_access: Rank1 publisher provides edition/scope metadata,not a complete accessible reusable dictionary. Rank2 poem editions are useful primary references with translation/territory rights gates. Rank3 is a separate contemporary25-piece tradition.
feasibility.rights: Review medieval original text,translation,critical edition,digital transcription,font and rune artwork separately. Dickins1915 USA public-domain notice does not authorize global English-corpus reuse. No modern copyrighted dictionary ingestion.
feasibility.no_automatic_expansion: Do not make Younger,Futhorc,blank,free-cast geometry or many spreads prerequisites for a bounded source-verified first release.

reusable_infrastructure.reusable: Supplied distinct IDs,unbiased integer selection,Fisher-Yates and UTF-8 seed framing can serve a named no-replacement draw profile without changing card outputs.
reusable_infrastructure.must_freeze: Rune-system canonical order/hash,source/edition ID,set count,eligible stones,draw count,position order,manual inputs,face/rotation policy and exact replay metadata.
reusable_infrastructure.must_not_reuse: Tarot or Lenormand meaning catalogs,78/36 assumptions,Celtic cuts,significators,card reversal stream probabilities or combination grammar.
reusable_infrastructure.physical_casting: Position/direction/overlap geometry of thrown stones is not equivalent to a deck shuffle;defer until independently sourced and specified.
